summary: Breaking: MigrationManager.Rollback(ctx, steps) rolls back only the requested number of migrations and `migrate down` defaults to one; rolling back every migration now requires RollbackAll or `migrate down --all`. Run takes a context. Migrations run under a Postgres advisory lock so concurrent replicas apply each migration once, statements get a default 30s lock_timeout (WithMigrationLockTimeout), and `-- +migrate Up/Down notransaction` migrations run outside a transaction.
